plugins.name: repo-standard-toolkit
plugins.description: Bootstraps and enforces enterprise repo hygiene in any codebase: scaffolds README / CHANGELOG / CONVENTIONS / CONTRIBUTING / CODE_OF_CONDUCT / SECURITY / LICENSE from published standards (Keep a Changelog, standard-readme, Contributor Covenant, SemVer), then installs a committed, dependency-free lint plus the CI gate that runs it, so the standard polices itself on every push, with or without Claude. Three further opt-in journeys extend the same lint: a generated banner and pill identity that re-renders byte-identical from one manifest with every claim traced to a real file, an enterprise writing profile (no em dashes, no AI-writing tells) swept with your approval and then locked, and a per-directory atlas that gives every governed directory a complete glossary of itself, one row per file, written from the file rather than from a listing, behind a fan-out the operator prices before it runs.

skills.name: atlas
skills.description: Give every directory a complete glossary of itself: one row per file, written from the file rather than from a listing, in one voice, on a fixed row grammar the committed lint holds forever. A gated fan-out reads every file it writes about, a normalization pass makes many agents sound like one, and a file header the sweep catches lying is reported as a finding rather than copied into a row. Use when a repo''s folder READMEs describe directories nobody re-read, when an index has drifted, or when a directory grew files nobody catalogued.
skills.description_zh: 逐文件读取内容，为每个目录生成完整文件词汇表，以统一语气和固定行格式写入目录索引，并用已提交 lint 持续校验；通过受控并行读取与归一化处理纠正索引漂移，发现不实文件头时作为问题报告。

skills.name: identity
skills.description: Give a repo a generated visual identity it can keep true forever: a deterministic banner and pill system rendered from one manifest, with the palette derived from the repo''s own design tokens (or a preset), every pill value traced to a real file so the lint can re-verify it, a rendered preview before anything is written, and lint enforcement of coverage, idiom, and zero drift. Asked, never assumed. Use when a repo wants per-folder READMEs and a front page that looks intentional, or to reconcile an identity that has drifted.
skills.description_zh: 应用户要求建立可持续校验的仓库视觉标识，由单一清单确定性生成横幅和标签，从仓库设计令牌或预设提取配色，并把标签值追溯到真实文件；写入前提供渲染预览，以 lint 检查覆盖、风格和漂移。

skills.name: scaffold
skills.description: Bootstrap or reconcile enterprise repo hygiene in the current repo: sense greenfield vs. mid-project, scaffold the missing meta docs (README / CHANGELOG / CONVENTIONS / CONTRIBUTING / CODE_OF_CONDUCT / SECURITY / LICENSE) from standards-grounded templates, bring drifted ones into compliance without clobbering prose, and install the committed dependency-free lint + CI gate so the standard polices itself on every push with or without Claude. Idempotent, so it is safe to re-run on any repo at any maturity. Use on a fresh repo, on a repo whose front matter has drifted, or to adopt the standard mid-project.
skills.description_zh: 为新建或已有仓库建立、补齐或协调企业规范文档，涵盖 README、CHANGELOG、CONVENTIONS、CONTRIBUTING、行为准则、安全和许可证；保留已有正文，并安装无依赖 lint 与 CI 门禁，支持幂等重复运行。

skills.name: voice
skills.description: Bring a repo''s prose up to the enterprise writing standard and then lock it: scan every governed doc for em dashes in any form and for the filler and AI-writing tells, rewrite each hit sentence by sentence with the operator approving the diff, then switch the profile on in the config so the committed lint holds the line on every future push. Gated and reversible; nothing is rewritten without a yes. Use before adopting the profile on an existing repo, or to clear a sweep the lint is now failing.
skills.description_zh: 扫描受管文档中的破折号、空话及模板化写作迹象，逐句提出改写差异并由操作者批准，再启用配置中的写作规范，让已提交 lint 约束后续推送；流程可逆，未获同意不改写。
